description.value: Originally known as Cherry Lane Liquor Store, this Penticton location now operates as Angry Otter Liquor under the Otter Co-op, a locally-owned cooperative with stores across BC. Situated on Main Street in Penticton, it is conveniently positioned for cyclists passing through the Okanagan. Stock options would include cold beverages suitable for touring riders, though no cycling-specific amenities have been confirmed.
